correctness.rationale: The exact code parity checks identify the doubled length-u GF(4) kernel. Three selected projective columns are dependent precisely when collinear; each such support gives exactly three nonzero kernel words, proving A6=3T(S). The 21-point/21-line design identities provide integer lower bounds for each u; u10/u11 unique infeasible occupancy vectors are excluded by a three-line pencil through the intersection of two empty lines. A provably exhaustive 2^21-mask recurrence then achieves every bound and counts every attaining labelled point subset. Standalone package verifier asserts geometry, moments, all minima and counts, direct witness T, and independently enumerates complete kernel words for u7,u8,u10,u11. No general/infinite-field proof is inferred from finite data.

value.rationale: All rank-three quaternary paired-locality codes in this family have identical stated distance six and dimension u-3, leaving a motivated reliability and enumerator optimization gap. The A6 coefficient counts undetected minimum-weight patterns, so its exact minimum is an operationally meaningful criterion. The result classifies all fifteen natural parameter sizes with sharp optima and counts and detects two intrinsically geometric obstructions to ideal incidence-profile bounds. This is not a trivial relabelling, merely a known distance-table re-evaluation, nor an arbitrary one-off slice.
